items.stem: Which sentence is the best topic sentence for a paragraph about why reading helps you?

options.text: Reading regularly builds a wider vocabulary.
options.rationale: Correct: it states one clear point the paragraph will prove.
A single word is not a topic sentence.

options.text: I read a lot and also I like pizza.

options.rationale: This signals an ending, not a paragraph's main point.
